applicability: Historical review of a closed leaf with no previously published comparison generation.
conditions: The recorded enclosure identifies exact source and memory commit endpoints.

statement: A closed leaf without a frozen review compares only its exact recorded source and memory endpoints; missing operands remain explicit.
